race.description: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Stakes (G3)
race.comment: SHADHAVAR (2) couldn't have been much more impressive winning the G2 Tristarc Stakes at Caulfield last start, rolling along in front and coming away to win well. She did have the pattern well and truly on side that day but she makes her own luck GOLD MEDALLIST (11) is going very well without winning this time in. She hit the line strongly for second in the G2 Rose Of Kingston over this route last start, she'll just need a good ride to find the running line from a wide gate. TERILEE (8) was excellent behind SHADHAVAR at Caulfield when closing off for second against the pattern. Would have loved 1600m for her but she'll be hard to hold out. STYLISH (1) won the Rose Of Kingston two back, game in The Invitation behind Lazzura last time. She meets GOLD MEDALLIST 3kg worse for a 0.5 length margin. BUTTERNUT PRINCESS (12) got home well for fourth in the Tristarc and has each way claims.
